question: In which year was Lakhimi Baruah awarded the Padma Shri for social work?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lakhimi Baruah** was awarded the Padma Shri in the year **2021** for her contributions in the field of social work.
 
• She is the founder of the **Konoklota Mahila Urban Cooperative Bank**, which is dedicated to empowering women in Assam.
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in India, recognizing distinguished contributions in various fields including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service and public affairs.
 
• Lakhimi Baruah's efforts have significantly contributed to the financial independence and empowerment of women in her community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards**

 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India and are categorized into three awards: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• Padma Vibhushan is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service, Padma Bhushan for distinguished service of a high order, and Padma Shri for distinguished service in any field.
 
• The awards are announced annually on the occasion of Republic Day.
 
• The awardees are selected based on their contributions to various disciplines such as arts, social work, public affairs, science and engineering, trade and industry, medicine, literature and education, sports, civil service, and others.
 
 
 
• **Konoklota Mahila Urban Cooperative Bank**
 
 
• Founded by Lakhimi Baruah, this bank aims to provide financial services to women, especially those who are economically disadvantaged.
 
• The bank offers various schemes and financial products that help women in starting their own businesses, thereby promoting women entrepreneurship and economic independence.
 
• It is a significant initiative towards the financial inclusion of women in the rural and urban areas of Assam.
